name: Zumtobel Group AG
summary: Zumtobel Group AG engages in the provision of lighting solutions. It operates through the Lighting and Components segments. The Lighting segment offers luminaires through the Thorn and Zumtobel brands. The Components segment includes the production of hardware and software for lighting systems. Its services include consulting on intelligent lighting management and emergency lighting, light contracting, design, project management, and new data-based solutions. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Dornbirn, Austria.
